The darker carbon details provide additional contrast against the red paintwork while highlighting the functional aerodynamic elements incorporated into the body. Ferrari developed the Speciale with active aerodynamic devices that balance downforce and drag according to the car’s speed and driving conditions. Movable flaps at the front and rear help the vehicle remain stable during higher-speed driving without introducing unnecessary aerodynamic resistance. The result is a design that is not merely more aggressive than the 458 Italia, but also more technically purposeful. Black Interior with Red Stitching Inside, the black cabin continues the understated exterior theme. Contrasting red stitching adds definition to the seats and interior surfaces while coordinating with the exterior colour. The 458 Speciale’s interior was intentionally designed around the driver. Unnecessary weight and visual distractions were reduced, leaving a focused environment with the steering wheel, Manettino driving-mode selector and major controls positioned within immediate reach. Lightweight materials and exposed technical finishes communicate the Speciale’s track-developed character, yet the cabin remains suitable for road use. The restrained black-and-red combination gives this example a timeless appearance that should continue to appeal long after more elaborate specifications have fallen out of fashion. Ferrari’s Naturally Aspirated V8 Masterpiece At the centre of the 458 Speciale is Ferrari’s 4.5-litre naturally aspirated V8. According to the official Ferrari 458 Speciale specifications , it produces 605 CV at 9,000 rpm and 540 Nm of torque at 6,000 rpm. Its specific output of 135 CV per litre was extraordinary for a naturally aspirated road-car engine. Unlike a turbocharged powerplant, the V8 delivers increasingly urgent performance as the revs rise, accompanied by the sharp throttle response and unmistakable soundtrack that made the Speciale one of Ferrari’s most acclaimed modern models. Power is sent to the rear wheels through a seven-speed F1 dual-clutch transmission. Ferrari quotes acceleration from 0 to 100 km/h in approximately three seconds and a top speed exceeding 325 km/h. Side Slip Control and Active Aerodynamics The Speciale introduced Ferrari’s Side Slip Angle Control system, commonly known as SSC. The technology analyses the car’s lateral movement and coordinates the electronic differential and traction-control systems to help the driver exploit the available grip. Its calibration was developed to make the car more responsive and engaging while retaining a degree of electronic support. Combined with revised suspension settings, carbon-ceramic braking and reduced weight, SSC gives the Speciale a level of precision beyond that of the standard 458 Italia. The car’s engineering remains impressive because it enhances driver involvement rather than disguising it. Steering inputs, throttle response and gear changes feel immediate, allowing the driver to experience the naturally aspirated V8 with exceptional clarity. A Significant Ferrari for Collectors The 458 Speciale belongs to an important line of Ferrari’s focused V8 models, following the 360 Challenge Stradale and F430 Scuderia. It was also the final special-series mid-engined Ferrari V8 coupé to use a naturally aspirated engine before the arrival of the turbocharged 488 Pista. That position in Ferrari history has made the Speciale particularly desirable among drivers and collectors. This car’s factory black roof, stripe-free presentation, exterior carbon trim and low mileage create a specification that stands apart without relying on aftermarket modifications. Black Leather and Alcantara Interior Inside, the cabin is upholstered in black leather, creating a focused and contemporary environment that allows the Verde Turbine exterior to remain the defining colour. Electrified Four-Wheel Drive The two front electric motors provide both traction and torque vectoring, allowing power to be managed independently across the front axle. This supports acceleration, cornering stability and all-wheel-drive capability without requiring a conventional mechanical connection to the front wheels. Multiple drive modes allow the Revuelto to prioritise electric driving, preserve battery energy or combine every element of the powertrain for maximum performance. The hybrid system therefore broadens the car’s range of abilities while retaining the response and sound of a naturally aspirated Lamborghini V12. Created as a modern interpretation of the legendary 300 SL Gullwing, the SLS introduced the iconic door arrangement to a new generation without directly recreating the original car. Each door opens upwards from the centre of the roof, transforming arrival into a distinctive part of the ownership experience. The design is functional as well as theatrical, contributing to the SLS AMG’s wide door openings and unmistakable silhouette. Production of the SLS AMG Coupé concluded in 2014, and its successor, the Mercedes-AMG GT, adopted conventional doors. This leaves the SLS occupying a unique position within Mercedes-Benz history as the marque’s final modern production gullwing. Red Leather Interior Opening the gullwing doors reveals a red leather cabin designed around the driver. The bold interior colour creates a dramatic contrast with the black exterior and highlights the cockpit-inspired layout. The dashboard, centre console and switchgear were influenced by aviation design, while the low seating position places the occupants close to the car’s centre of gravity. Metal gearshift paddles and a compact AMG performance steering wheel provide direct control over the transmission. AMG’s Naturally Aspirated V8 The SLS AMG was the first road car developed entirely in-house by Mercedes-AMG. Its centrepiece is the hand-built M159 naturally aspirated V8, with an exact displacement of 6,208 cc and marketed by AMG as a 6.3-litre engine. It produces 420 kW, equivalent to 571 hp, and 650 Nm of torque. Power is sent to the rear wheels through an AMG SPEEDSHIFT seven-speed dual-clutch transmission mounted at the rear in a transaxle arrangement. Mercedes-AMG recorded acceleration from 0–100 km/h in 3.8 seconds and an electronically limited maximum speed of 317 km/h. The naturally aspirated engine delivers immediate response and a distinctive V8 soundtrack without turbocharging or hybrid assistance. Aluminium Spaceframe Engineering The SLS AMG uses a lightweight aluminium spaceframe weighing approximately 241 kilograms. Its engine is positioned behind the front axle, contributing to a front-to-rear weight distribution of approximately 47:53. A carbon-fibre driveshaft connects the engine to the rear-mounted transmission, while an integrated mechanical limited-slip differential helps transfer power to the road. This layout gives the SLS a balanced character that combines high-speed stability with the engagement expected from a rear-wheel-drive supercar. Available from Exotic Cars Dubai With only 15,000 kilometres recorded, this black-over-red 2011 SLS AMG offers considerable appeal to collectors and enthusiasts. Its naturally aspirated AMG V8, aluminium construction and roof-hinged doors make it an important part of Mercedes-Benz history and the last production gullwing from the marque to date. Mercedes-Benz and McLaren Engineering The SLR was created through a partnership between Mercedes-Benz and McLaren, combining German powertrain engineering with McLaren’s expertise in carbon-fibre construction and Formula One technology. Its long bonnet, side-exit exhausts, distinctive nose and upward-opening butterfly doors reference both contemporary Formula One machinery and the legendary Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR racing car of 1955. The result is a design that remains immediately recognisable more than two decades after its introduction. Production took place in Woking, England, while the engine was assembled in Affalterbach according to AMG’s “one man, one engine” principle. 626 PS Supercharged V8 Power comes from a hand-assembled 5,439 cc AMG V8 engine fitted with a mechanical supercharger. It produces 626 PS and 780 Nm of torque, delivered to the rear wheels through an AMG SPEEDSHIFT R five-speed automatic transmission. Official Mercedes-Benz figures quote acceleration from 0–100 km/h in approximately 3.8 seconds and a maximum speed of 334 km/h. These figures remain impressive today, but the SLR’s character is defined just as much by its immense torque, distinctive supercharger sound and dramatic side-exit exhaust system. Three manual transmission programmes allow the driver to adjust the speed and character of the gear changes. Carbon-Fibre Construction and Active Aerodynamics The SLR McLaren was built around a carbon-fibre-reinforced monocoque, a highly advanced construction method for a road car launched in the early 2000s. Carbon-fibre crash structures were also used to combine low weight with exceptional energy absorption. Its carbon-ceramic C-BRAKE system employs eight-piston front and four-piston rear brake callipers. cars.title: Aston Martin DB11 AMR V12
cars.description: Overview — Aston Martin's Most Powerful DB11, Now in Dubai The 2021 Aston Martin DB11 AMR V12 is the pinnacle of the DB11 range — the Aston Martin Racing Edition that takes the already-exceptional DB11 V12 and elevates it to the very limits of road car performance and specification. The AMR designation — drawn directly from Aston Martin's racing programme — brings a host of performance enhancements, visual upgrades, and exclusive appointments that mark this as the most desirable and focused DB11 ever produced. This stunning example, finished in sleek Black with a dramatic Red interior , is now available at Exotic Cars Dubai . For the buyer seeking the ultimate British grand tourer in Dubai — maximum V12 performance, race-inspired character, and handbuilt Aston Martin craftsmanship — the DB11 AMR is the undisputed answer. AMR Performance — 630HP V12, Race-Inspired Engineering The DB11 AMR is powered by Aston Martin's 5.2-litre twin-turbocharged V12 engine , re-tuned by the AMR division to produce 630 horsepower and 700 Nm of torque — an increase of 22 horsepower over the standard DB11 V12. This exceptional powertrain launches the DB11 AMR from 0–100 km/h in 3.7 seconds with a top speed of 334 km/h — making it the fastest-ever DB11 at the time of its introduction. The AMR-specific suspension tuning , recalibrated steering, and uprated carbon ceramic braking system sharpen the DB11's dynamic responses into something altogether more focused and driver-centric — a grand tourer that rewards commitment and skill with a level of communication, precision, and exhilaration that only an Aston Martin built at Gaydon can deliver. cars.title: Ferrari Roma
cars.description: 2021 Ferrari Roma for Sale in Dubai Explore this elegant 2021 Ferrari Roma for sale in Dubai , finished in a timeless Black exterior with a striking Red interior. This classic Ferrari colour combination complements the Roma’s sophisticated grand-touring design, combining understated exterior styling with a cabin that delivers a far more expressive visual character. With its front-mounted twin-turbocharged V8, eight-speed dual-clutch transmission and contemporary 2+2 cabin, the Ferrari Roma offers an appealing balance of performance, refinement and everyday versatility. Timeless Black Exterior The Black exterior enhances the Roma’s clean, flowing bodywork while preserving the restrained character envisioned by the Ferrari Styling Centre. Rather than relying on oversized aerodynamic components, the Roma uses carefully sculpted surfaces, elegant proportions and discreet technical details to create its distinctive presence. Its long bonnet, compact passenger compartment and muscular rear section draw inspiration from classic front-engined Ferrari grand tourers. Slim LED headlights and the distinctive front grille provide a modern interpretation of traditional Ferrari design, while flush exterior detailing helps maintain a smooth and uncluttered profile. The Roma also features an active rear spoiler integrated into the bodywork. It deploys automatically according to the vehicle’s speed and selected driving mode, providing additional aerodynamic support without disrupting the car’s elegant silhouette when not required. Striking Red Interior Opening the door reveals a vibrant Red interior that creates an immediate contrast against the Black bodywork. The cabin adopts Ferrari’s distinctive dual-cockpit concept, creating separate yet visually connected environments for the driver and passenger. The driver sits behind a fully digital instrument display, with the steering wheel placing many of the principal vehicle controls within easy reach. A vertically positioned central display provides access to the infotainment and cabin settings while maintaining the dashboard’s sculpted design. The Red interior brings warmth and character to the otherwise understated specification. It also reinforces the connection with Ferrari’s sporting heritage while remaining appropriate for the Roma’s refined grand-touring identity. Twin-Turbocharged Ferrari V8 According to Ferrari’s official Roma specifications , the model is powered by a 3,855 cc twin-turbocharged V8 producing 620 CV. Maximum torque reaches 760 Nm, providing strong acceleration throughout the engine’s operating range. Ferrari quotes acceleration from 0–100 km/h in approximately 3.4 seconds, with 0–200 km/h achieved in around 9.3 seconds. Its quoted maximum speed exceeds 320 km/h. These figures are manufacturer specifications for the Ferrari Roma model and should not be interpreted as independently measured performance figures for this individual vehicle. Eight-Speed Dual-Clutch Transmission Power is delivered to the rear wheels through an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. The gearbox provides rapid changes during performance driving while offering smooth operation in more relaxed conditions. Gear selection can be controlled through the steering-column-mounted paddles, allowing the driver to remain actively involved when desired. Ferrari’s Manettino driving-mode selector also makes it possible to adjust the vehicle’s dynamic responses according to the road conditions and intended style of driving. Modern Grand-Touring Character The Roma was developed to combine Ferrari performance with the comfort and flexibility required for longer journeys. Its front-mid-engined layout helps produce balanced handling, while the compact rear seating area provides additional space for occasional passengers or luggage. This makes the Roma more versatile than a conventional two-seat supercar without diluting the responsiveness expected from a Ferrari. It can perform as a refined city car or long-distance grand tourer before delivering far more focused performance when the opportunity arises. The Black exterior and Red interior suit this dual personality particularly well. From the outside, the car appears discreet and sophisticated; inside, the vivid cabin introduces the sense of theatre expected from an Italian performance car. Available from Exotic Cars Dubai This 2021 Ferrari Roma presents an attractive opportunity for a buyer seeking contemporary Ferrari engineering in a timeless and highly recognisable colour combination. The precise mileage, options, documentation and vehicle condition can be confirmed directly with the Exotic Cars team. cars.title: Ferrari F8 Spider
cars.description: Very Low-Mileage 2021 Ferrari F8 Spider for Sale in Dubai Matt Grey with a Beige Interior This very low-mileage 2021 Ferrari F8 Spider for sale in Dubai is presented in an elegant Matt Grey exterior with a contrasting Beige interior. Its road-focused specification includes comfort seats, carbon-fibre door-sill trim, interior carbon fibre and a front suspension lift system. The understated colour combination provides a refined interpretation of Ferrari’s open-top V8 supercar. Its Beige cabin and comfort equipment make it suitable for longer journeys, while the 720 CV twin-turbocharged engine and advanced chassis systems preserve the performance expected from an F8 Spider. Sophisticated Matt Grey Exterior The Matt Grey finish gives the F8 Spider a purposeful yet restrained appearance. Its non-reflective surface emphasises the vehicle’s flowing lines, deep aerodynamic channels and muscular rear arches without relying on a more conventional bright Ferrari colour. The neutral exterior works particularly well with the F8’s technical design. Details such as the front S-Duct, sculpted bonnet and pronounced side intakes remain clearly visible, while the low roofline and compact rear bodywork reinforce its mid-engined proportions. At the back, four circular taillights reference earlier Ferrari V8 models. The rear spoiler is integrated neatly into the body, preserving a clean appearance while contributing to high-speed aerodynamic performance. Refined Beige Interior Inside, the Beige interior introduces a warmer and more traditional atmosphere. Its lighter colour creates an appealing contrast with the Matt Grey exterior and gives the compact two-seat cockpit a greater sense of openness. The cabin remains unmistakably driver-focused. Important controls are located on the steering wheel, including the Manettino driving-mode selector, indicators and engine start button. Large fixed paddle shifters provide direct control of the seven-speed dual-clutch transmission. Beige upholstery also creates an effective background for the dark carbon-fibre trim, allowing the interior’s performance materials to remain clearly visible. Comfort Seats This F8 Spider is fitted with comfort seats, providing a more accommodating design for road use than fixed racing buckets. They combine the support required during enthusiastic driving with a seating position suited to longer journeys and everyday use. The comfort-seat specification complements the Beige interior and gives the cabin a more grand-touring character without compromising the F8 Spider’s performance-focused layout. Interior Carbon and Carbon Door Sills Carbon-fibre trim introduces a technical contrast throughout the cabin. The exposed composite weave reflects Ferrari’s motorsport experience and ensures that the interior retains a sporting atmosphere despite its lighter Beige colour scheme. Carbon-fibre door-sill trim provides an additional detail at the entrance to the cabin. It becomes visible whenever the doors are opened and creates a clear transition between the sculpted exterior and driver-focused interior. Front Suspension Lift A front suspension lift system adds valuable everyday usability. It temporarily raises the front of the vehicle, providing additional clearance when approaching steep ramps, speed humps and raised entrances. The feature is especially useful on a low mid-engined supercar in an urban environment. Once the obstacle has been passed, the F8 Spider can return to its normal driving height. 720 CV Twin-Turbocharged V8 According to Ferrari’s official F8 Spider specifications , the model is powered by a 3.9-litre twin-turbocharged V8 producing 720 CV. The engine generates 770 Nm of torque and sends power to the rear wheels through a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission. Ferrari quotes acceleration from 0–100 km/h in 2.9 seconds, 0–200 km/h in 8.2 seconds and a maximum speed of 340 km/h. These manufacturer figures are provided as model-level information and may vary according to road, tyre, weather and vehicle conditions. The engine delivers substantial torque at lower speeds while maintaining the immediate response and progressive power delivery associated with Ferrari’s V8 models. Advanced Aerodynamics Ferrari developed the F8 Spider’s aerodynamics to generate greater stability without relying on visually excessive wings. The S-Duct at the front channels air through the body and over the bonnet, contributing additional downforce at speed. Airflow is also carefully managed around the side intakes and rear bodywork to support cooling and aerodynamic balance. These functional elements are integrated into the design rather than added as separate components. Side Slip Control and Driver Assistance The F8 Spider uses Ferrari’s Side Slip Control system to coordinate the traction control, electronic differential, adaptive suspension and other chassis technologies. Ferrari Dynamic Enhancer Plus can adjust braking pressure at individual wheels to help make the car’s behaviour more predictable during enthusiastic driving. The system supports the driver without removing the responsive character of the rear-wheel-drive chassis. Different Manettino settings allow the vehicle’s behaviour to be adjusted for changing conditions, from more controlled road configurations to sharper performance modes. Retractable Hardtop The retractable hardtop enables the F8 Spider to combine the security and refinement of a coupé with open-air driving. The roof can open or close in approximately 14 seconds and can be operated at speeds of up to 45 km/h. When lowered, the roof stores behind the occupants while maintaining the car’s dramatic mid-engined profile. With the cabin open, the sound of the twin-turbocharged V8 becomes a more direct part of the driving experience. A Desirable Modern V8 Ferrari The F8 Spider represents an important chapter in Ferrari’s mid-engined history. It combines one of the marque’s most highly developed non-hybrid V8 powertrains with a retractable hardtop and modern electronic chassis technology. This example’s very low mileage, Matt Grey exterior and Beige comfort interior give it particular appeal. Interior carbon, carbon door-sill trim and the suspension lift provide a considered balance between technical character and road usability. cars.title: Lamborghini Huracan STO
cars.description: 2022 Lamborghini Huracán STO in Grey with Blue Accents Track-Inspired Performance for the Road This 2022 Lamborghini Huracan STO for sale in Dubai combines uncompromising performance with an exceptionally distinctive colour specification. Its Grey exterior is enhanced by contrasting Blue accents, while exterior carbon-fibre elements reinforce the purposeful design of Lamborghini’s road-homologated track car. The same theme continues inside, where Alcantara upholstery, Blue detailing and carbon-fibre trim create a focused driving environment. Every aspect of this specification complements the Huracán STO’s lightweight construction, naturally aspirated V10 engine and motorsport-derived engineering. STO stands for Super Trofeo Omologata , reflecting the model’s connection to Lamborghini Squadra Corse and the racing technology developed for the Huracán Super Trofeo EVO and GT3 EVO. Grey Exterior with Blue Accents The Grey exterior gives this Huracán STO a technical and contemporary appearance, allowing its aerodynamic bodywork to remain the main visual focus. Strategically positioned Blue accents add contrast and emphasise the vehicle’s sharp lines, air channels and competition-inspired profile. Exterior carbon fibre adds another layer of visual drama while remaining entirely appropriate for a model built around weight reduction and aerodynamic performance. The STO’s unmistakable design includes its prominent rear wing, roof-mounted air intake, shark fin and aggressive rear diffuser. One of the model’s defining engineering features is the carbon-fibre Cofango. Its name combines the Italian words cofano , meaning bonnet, and parafango , meaning wing or fender. This motorsport-inspired structure integrates the bonnet, front wings and bumper into a single lightweight component, improving access while supporting aerodynamic efficiency. Alcantara and Carbon-Fibre Interior Inside, the Alcantara interior maintains the performance-focused character established by the exterior. Blue accents provide a distinctive contrast and connect the cabin with the detailing across the bodywork. Carbon-fibre interior elements reinforce the lightweight approach without detracting from the clarity of the driving environment. The dashboard, centre console and essential controls are arranged around the driver, creating the sense of sitting in a road-legal competition car rather than a conventional luxury supercar. The steering wheel provides access to the model’s dedicated driving settings. STO mode is intended for road driving, Trofeo sharpens the vehicle for dry performance use, and Pioggia adjusts its behaviour for wet conditions. These modes alter the responses of the engine, transmission, traction systems and chassis to suit the selected environment. Naturally Aspirated V10 Performance At the centre of the Huracán STO is Lamborghini’s 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V10. It produces 640 CV at 8,000 rpm and 565 Nm of torque at 6,500 rpm, sending power exclusively to the rear wheels through a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission. According to Lamborghini’s official Huracán STO specifications , the model can accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in 3.0 seconds and from 0 to 200 km/h in 9.0 seconds. Its maximum speed is rated at 310 km/h. These are Lamborghini’s model-level performance figures and have not been independently measured for this individual vehicle. Unlike many contemporary performance cars, the STO relies on a naturally aspirated engine without turbocharging or hybrid assistance. Its progressive power delivery, immediate throttle response and high-revving soundtrack are central to the driving experience. Lightweight Motorsport Engineering The Huracán STO has a dry weight of approximately 1,339 kilograms, creating a power-to-weight ratio of just 2.09 kilograms per CV. Extensive carbon-fibre construction plays an essential role in achieving this figure, with Lamborghini using the material throughout the body and aerodynamic package. Its manually adjustable rear wing allows the aerodynamic balance to be configured, while the roof scoop and shark fin help manage airflow towards the engine and rear section. Lamborghini also developed a wider track, revised suspension geometry and dedicated steering calibration to deliver greater accuracy and stability. Braking is handled by motorsport-derived CCM-R carbon-ceramic technology, developed to provide strong stopping performance and resistance to fade during demanding driving. Lamborghini quotes a braking distance of approximately 30 metres from 100 km/h. A Highly Distinctive STO Specification The combination of Grey paintwork, Blue exterior accents and exposed carbon fibre gives this Huracán STO an appearance that is both technical and unmistakably individual. Its Alcantara cabin, matching Blue details and interior carbon continue the theme without separating the design from the car’s motorsport purpose. It is a specification that rewards closer inspection. The Grey finish allows the sculpted aerodynamic surfaces to remain clearly visible, while the Blue highlights draw attention to selected areas of the body and cabin. Carbon fibre provides the finishing link between the visual specification and the engineering beneath it. Available from Exotic Cars Dubai Discover further examples through the Lamborghini collection at Exotic Cars Dubai , including performance, limited-production and collector-focused models. You can also explore the complete vehicle inventory on the Exotic Cars Dubai website or visit the Exotic Cars Dubai showroom to view this 2022 Lamborghini Huracán STO and discuss its complete specification with the sales team.

cars.title: Alfa Romeo Giulia Supersport
cars.description: 2025 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport in Etna Red A Limited-Production Italian Performance Saloon This 2025 Alfa Romeo Giulia Supersport for sale in Dubai is the limited-production Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport, presented as brand new and showing only 500 kilometres. Finished in three-layer Etna Red with a Black-and-Red interior, it features extensive exterior and interior carbon fibre, a 520 hp twin-turbocharged V6 and a five-year warranty. The Super Sport is more than a styling package. Alfa Romeo created it as a global limited edition celebrating the marque’s first victory at the Mille Miglia in 1928. Only 275 examples of the Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport were produced worldwide, making this a particularly significant version of Alfa Romeo’s highly regarded performance saloon. Three-Layer Etna Red Exterior Etna Red, also known as Rosso Etna, is one of the three official colours offered for the Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport. Its multi-layer finish gives the bodywork considerable depth, appearing darker across the sculpted surfaces and becoming more vibrant under direct light. The colour complements the Giulia’s compact proportions, long bonnet and muscular rear haunches. Traditional Alfa Romeo design elements remain prominent, including the central Scudetto grille, offset front registration position and circular body surfaces that create a sense of movement even when the car is stationary. Super Sport models can be identified by a redesigned Quadrifoglio emblem. For the first time in more than 100 years of the badge’s history, the traditional white triangular background was replaced with Black. This seemingly small detail gives the famous four-leaf clover a more contemporary appearance and distinguishes the limited edition from a regular Giulia Quadrifoglio. Exterior Carbon-Fibre Specification Carbon fibre plays both a visual and structural role throughout this Giulia. Visible exterior elements reinforce the car’s performance-led identity while providing a sharp contrast against the Etna Red bodywork. The Super Sport incorporates exposed carbon fibre around its distinctive front grille treatment and mirror housings. An active carbon-fibre front splitter is positioned beneath the bumper and deploys according to the vehicle’s aerodynamic requirements, helping control airflow below the car during higher-speed driving. Additional lightweight construction can be found throughout the Quadrifoglio platform. Alfa Romeo uses carbon fibre for the driveshaft, bonnet, rear spoiler and selected body elements, contributing to the Giulia’s balanced handling and favourable power-to-weight ratio. Burnished 19-inch Teledial alloy wheels and Black brake callipers complete the Super Sport’s exterior appearance. The classic five-hole wheel design is closely associated with Alfa Romeo, giving the car a recognisable connection to earlier performance models. Black-and-Red Performance Interior Inside, the Black-and-Red colour combination continues the theme established by the Etna Red exterior. The cabin is shaped around the driver, with the dashboard, centre console and principal controls positioned to create a focused driving environment. Red accents and stitching provide contrast against the predominantly Black surfaces. The front headrests feature embroidered Super Sport identification and individual limited-edition numbering, confirming the model’s place within the worldwide production run. The steering wheel combines leather and Alcantara with carbon-fibre accents. A centrally positioned engine-start button and large transmission paddles allow the driver to access the car’s principal performance functions without moving their hands far from the wheel. Exclusive Red Carbon-Fibre Interior Trim One of the defining features of the Super Sport edition is its newly developed three-dimensional carbon-fibre trim with a Red weave. It appears across the dashboard, centre tunnel and door panels, creating a finish that is visually different from conventional gloss or matt woven carbon fibre. The Red fibres connect the technical material to the exterior paint and cabin accents. Their three-dimensional appearance changes according to the viewing angle and surrounding light, giving the interior a more distinctive and bespoke atmosphere. Rather than using carbon fibre as an isolated decorative element, Alfa Romeo incorporates it consistently throughout the cabin. The result is an interior that feels closely related to the Quadrifoglio’s engineering and lightweight construction. One of Only 275 Giulia Super Sport Models The official Alfa Romeo Quadrifoglio Super Sport announcement confirms that worldwide production was restricted to 275 Giulia models and 175 Stelvio models. The name commemorates Alfa Romeo’s victory in the 1928 Mille Miglia. Giuseppe Campari and Giulio Ramponi won the demanding 1,621-kilometre race in an Alfa Romeo 6C 1500 Super Sport, completing the event in 19 hours, 14 minutes and five seconds. That result became the first of Alfa Romeo’s record eleven Mille Miglia victories. The modern Super Sport connects the Giulia Quadrifoglio to that history through its limited production, redesigned badge and carefully selected performance details. The Correct 520 hp Twin-Turbocharged V6 Despite the generic engine field currently shown on the vehicle advert, the Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport is not powered by a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine. Its correct powertrain is Alfa Romeo’s all-aluminium 2.9-litre twin-turbocharged V6, producing 520 hp. Power is delivered to the rear wheels through a rapid eight-speed automatic transmission. The large, column-mounted aluminium paddles allow manual control while remaining stationary as the steering wheel turns. A mechanical limited-slip differential uses calibration developed from the Giulia GTA programme. It helps optimise torque transfer across the rear axle, improving traction, stability and agility during acceleration and cornering. The Giulia Quadrifoglio can accelerate from 0–100 km/h in approximately 3.9 seconds and reach a top speed of 307 km/h. An Akrapovič exhaust system gives the V6 a more pronounced sound while reducing weight and reinforcing the Super Sport’s performance character. Driver-Focused Chassis and Technology Near-equal weight distribution, direct steering and the extensive use of aluminium and carbon fibre give the Giulia a notably responsive character. Its double-wishbone front suspension and carefully developed rear arrangement allow the chassis to respond quickly while maintaining composure during everyday driving. The Alfa DNA selector provides several driving configurations, including the Quadrifoglio-specific Race setting. This sharpens the engine, transmission and chassis responses for more demanding use. A fully digital 12.3-inch instrument display offers multiple layouts. The dedicated Race layout prioritises the tachometer, speed, gear-selection information and shift lights, giving the driver a clear view of essential performance data. Available from Exotic Cars Dubai This Etna Red Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport combines limited production with one of the most engaging modern performance-saloon platforms. Presented as brand new with only 500 kilometres, it features a Black-and-Red interior, exterior and interior carbon fibre, 520 hp V6 performance and a five-year warranty. Explore the Alfa Romeo collection at Exotic Cars Dubai , browse the complete inventory through the Exotic Cars Dubai website , or visit the Exotic Cars showroom to experience this limited-production Giulia Super Sport in person.

The deep green tone changes character according to the surrounding light, appearing subtle in the shade and revealing more depth under direct illumination. It provides an effective contrast against the Black Badge exterior treatment, which replaces traditional brightwork with darker, more technical finishes. This combination of Monteverde paintwork and dark exterior detailing gives the car an individual presence from every angle. The lighter Ivory surfaces give the interior an open and calming atmosphere, while Grey sections introduce contrast and help define the shape of the seats, door panels and surrounding trim. Depending on the individual commission, these designs can contain tens of thousands of precisely positioned perforations. This car’s Ivory and Grey treatment reflects that same attention to texture, contrast and material quality without overwhelming the cabin’s elegant colour palette. Ventilated seating provides an additional level of comfort during warmer conditions. Air circulation through the perforated surfaces helps maintain a more comfortable environment while preserving the softness and appearance of the leather. Starlight Headliner and Bespoke Audio Above the occupants, the Starlight Headliner transforms the roof into a carefully arranged field of fibre-optic light. Its soft illumination creates a distinctive atmosphere after dark and has become one of the most recognisable expressions of modern Rolls-Royce craftsmanship. The lighting remains subtle enough to complement the Ivory and Grey interior rather than dominating it. When combined with the cabin’s ambient illumination, it creates a calm environment for both front and rear occupants. The Bespoke Audio system has been developed around the shape and acoustic properties of the Cullinan’s interior. Carefully positioned speakers create a detailed and immersive soundstage, allowing music to be experienced clearly throughout the cabin. The extensive insulation and refinement of the Cullinan provide an exceptionally quiet foundation for the system. Rear Entertainment and Picnic Tables Rear entertainment screens allow passengers to access media during longer journeys, adding another layer of convenience to the rear compartment. Their integration preserves the clean appearance of the seatbacks and ensures that technology does not distract from the surrounding craftsmanship. Picnic tables provide a practical surface for working, reading or enjoying refreshments while travelling. When no longer required, they fold neatly into the front seatbacks, maintaining the uncluttered appearance of the cabin. The combination of rear entertainment, picnic tables, ventilated seating and Bespoke Audio makes the rear passenger area suitable for both business and relaxation. Importantly, these features have been incorporated without compromising the sense of space or the calm, carefully balanced atmosphere of the interior. Black Badge V12 Performance According to the official Rolls-Royce Black Badge Cullinan Series II information, the model preserves its enhanced Black Badge performance while introducing the updated Series II design and technology. Its 6.75-litre twin-turbocharged V12 produces 600 PS and 900 Nm of torque. Power is delivered through an eight-speed automatic transmission and permanent all-wheel-drive system, providing effortless acceleration without disturbing the composed character expected from a Rolls-Royce. The Black Badge calibration introduces a more immediate response from the accelerator and transmission. Its exhaust system also produces a deeper tone under stronger acceleration while remaining appropriately restrained during relaxed driving. Rolls-Royce’s self-levelling air suspension continuously adapts to the surface below, helping preserve the marque’s celebrated Magic Carpet Ride. Despite the Cullinan’s substantial dimensions, the combination of all-wheel drive and carefully managed suspension allows it to remain controlled, composed and remarkably easy to drive. Cullinan Series II Technology The Series II interior introduces the SPIRIT digital operating system, allowing the instrument displays to be coordinated with the colours selected for the vehicle’s interior or exterior. Digital functions are integrated alongside traditional craftsmanship rather than replacing it. A Spirit of Ecstasy figurine is positioned within the illuminated Clock Cabinet on the dashboard, bringing the marque’s defining emblem into the cabin. The surrounding fascia and interior lighting create a gradual sequence when the vehicle is entered. Rolls-Royce also introduced new contemporary materials and personalisation possibilities for the Series II generation. The official Black Badge Cullinan Series II announcement confirms its 600 PS output, 900 Nm of torque and expanded use of bespoke interior techniques. The Monteverde exterior works beautifully with the Ivory and Grey perforated cabin, while the Starlight Headliner, Bespoke Audio, rear entertainment, picnic tables and ventilated seating provide an exceptionally complete luxury environment. cars.description: 2025 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet in Nardo Grey An Elegant Open-Top Sports Car for Everyday Driving This 2025 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet for sale in Dubai combines the timeless shape of the Porsche 911 with an elegant and highly usable specification. Finished in Nardo Grey with an Ivory interior, it features Spyder-design wheels, a sports exhaust system, ventilated seats and a BOSE audio system. The Carrera Cabriolet offers the performance and precision expected from a 911 while remaining comfortable enough for regular use. Its rear-mounted flat-six engine, rapid PDK transmission and carefully developed chassis provide an engaging driving experience, while the electrically operated roof brings an additional sense of freedom to every journey. This example is also offered with warranty coverage until March 2027. Nardo Grey Exterior The Nardo Grey exterior gives the 911 a clean and contemporary appearance. Its solid grey tone highlights the flowing roofline, muscular rear haunches and carefully sculpted bodywork without drawing attention away from the shape itself. Porsche has continuously evolved the 911’s appearance while preserving its defining proportions. The low bonnet, circular headlights, compact cabin and rear-mounted engine remain instantly recognisable, while modern aerodynamic details improve cooling, stability and efficiency. With the fabric roof lowered, the Carrera Cabriolet retains the balanced profile of the coupé. When closed, the roof follows the original 911 silhouette closely, helping the car maintain an elegant appearance in either configuration. The electrically operated system can complete its movement in approximately 12 seconds and can be used while travelling at lower speeds. Spyder-Design Wheels The Spyder-design alloy wheels introduce a more purposeful motorsport influence to the understated Nardo Grey exterior. Their detailed multi-spoke construction creates a stronger visual connection to Porsche’s higher-performance and track-focused models. The open wheel design also provides a clear view of the braking system and gives the car a wider, more planted appearance. Against the simple grey bodywork, the intricate spokes add visual contrast without making the overall specification feel excessive. Together with the sports exhaust and Cabriolet body style, the wheels help give this Carrera an individual identity while retaining the sophisticated appearance expected from a modern Porsche 911. Ivory Interior with Ventilated Seats The Ivory interior creates a refined contrast against the Nardo Grey bodywork. Its lighter tone makes the cabin feel open and inviting, particularly when the roof is lowered, while also highlighting the quality and precision of Porsche’s interior craftsmanship. The dashboard maintains the horizontal architecture traditionally associated with the 911, but introduces modern digital displays and the Porsche Communication Management touchscreen. At the front, Lamborghini developed the carbon-fibre “Cofango”, a single assembly combining the bonnet and front wings. Full Exterior Carbon Fibre This example benefits from a full exterior carbon-fibre specification, enhancing the technical appearance created by the Ad Personam Matt Red and Matt Black paintwork. The exposed composite material provides a purposeful contrast and draws attention to the STO’s complex aerodynamic design. Carbon fibre is fundamental to the model rather than being used solely for decoration. Lamborghini states that more than 75 per cent of the STO’s body panels are manufactured from carbon fibre. Aerospace-inspired construction methods, thinner glass, reduced sound insulation and additional lightweight materials helped make the STO approximately 43 kilograms lighter than the Huracan Performante. The rear wing can be manually adjusted into three positions, allowing the aerodynamic balance to be altered. The roof scoop directs air towards the engine compartment, while the shark fin improves stability during cornering. Each component has been shaped around airflow, cooling or downforce. Black Alcantara with Red Accents The interior follows the same focused approach as the exterior. Black Alcantara covers the principal cabin surfaces, creating a low-reflection environment inspired by competition cars. Red accents connect the cabin to the Ad Personam exterior and highlight selected areas throughout the cockpit. The contrasting details give the interior a clear visual identity without distracting from its primary purpose. Carbon-fibre surfaces and lightweight materials contribute to the motorsport atmosphere, while the low seating position places the driver close to the centre of the car. A roll cage further distinguishes this particular example. It reinforces the visual relationship between the road-going STO and Lamborghini’s Super Trofeo racing cars, giving the cabin a more purposeful character from the moment the door is opened. The digital instrument display changes according to the selected driving mode, while the central touchscreen provides access to vehicle information, entertainment and telemetry functions. The steering wheel, extended paddle shifters and clearly positioned controls ensure that the principal driving functions remain within immediate reach. A 640 CV Naturally Aspirated V10 According to the official Lamborghini Huracan STO specification , the car is powered by a naturally aspirated 5.2-litre V10 producing 640 CV at 8,000 rpm and 565 Nm of torque at 6,500 rpm. Power is sent exclusively to the rear wheels through a seven-speed Lamborghini dual-clutch transmission. This configuration distinguishes the STO from the all-wheel-drive Huracan EVO and places greater emphasis on driver involvement, throttle control and chassis balance. Lamborghini records acceleration from 0–100 km/h in 3.0 seconds, 0–200 km/h in 9.0 seconds and a maximum speed of 310 km/h. However, the defining characteristic is the V10’s responsiveness. Without turbocharging, the engine delivers immediate reactions and builds towards its maximum output with a progressive, high-revving character. Super Trofeo Omologata STO stands for Super Trofeo Omologata, reflecting the model’s connection to the Huracan Super Trofeo EVO and Huracan GT3 racing cars. Lamborghini developed the STO to transfer the sensation and technology of its competition models into a road-legal supercar. The standard driving modes have been replaced by three STO-specific configurations. STO mode is intended for road use, Trofeo sharpens the car for dry circuit driving, and Pioggia optimises traction and vehicle control in wet or slippery conditions. Rear-wheel steering improves agility during tighter manoeuvres and supports stability at higher speeds. The fixed steering ratio provides more consistent feedback, while the suspension, throttle calibration, transmission and electronic systems have all been tuned around the STO’s track-focused purpose. Its CCM-R braking system was developed with Brembo using technology derived from Formula One. The specialised carbon-ceramic discs are supported by dedicated cooling channels, providing greater resistance to heat and more consistent braking during demanding use. We are proud to offer this 2023 Lamborghini Urus Performante, the most extreme version of Lamborghini’s game-changing Super SUV. Finished in an eye-catching White and Black two-tone exterior with a dynamic Black and Orange interior, and enhanced with full carbon fibre exterior and interior packages, this Urus is built for thrill-seekers who demand the best. Incredible Speed and Capability The 2023 Urus Performante is powered by a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, tuned to deliver an exhilarating 657 horsepower and 850 Nm of torque. Coupled with an 8-speed automatic transmission and Lamborghini’s advanced all-wheel-drive system, it launches from 0 to 100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds, with a top speed of 306 km/h. A re-engineered suspension, weight reduction measures, and sharper driving modes give the Performante a track-ready edge without sacrificing comfort. Exquisite Exterior Design The aggressive White and Black exterior is accentuated by the Performante-exclusive carbon fibre body enhancements, including the front splitter, hood, roof, rear diffuser, and aerodynamic wing. Sleek Y-shaped LED headlights, large hexagonal air intakes, and lightweight forged alloy wheels complete the unmistakable Lamborghini presence. Every curve is designed for aerodynamic efficiency and visual drama. Luxurious and Athletic Interior Inside, the Black and Orange cabin delivers a perfect mix of sportiness and luxury. Carbon fibre trim covers the dashboard, center console, and door panels, while Alcantara and fine leather provide premium comfort. The driver-focused cockpit includes a configurable digital display, Lamborghini Infotainment System III, and advanced connectivity. Rear passengers enjoy ample space and the same bespoke detailing. cars.title: Bentley Mulsanne Speed V8
cars.description: Welcome to Exotic Cars Dubai, your premier destination for luxury and performance vehicles in the UAE. We are delighted to offer this used 2017 Bentley Mulsanne Speed, a testament to Bentley's craftsmanship and dedication to luxury. This stunning sedan features a deep blue exterior and an exquisite tan and black interior, equipped with a Naim sound system, diamond-stitched seats, rear entertainment, massage seats, and many more high-end features. The 2017 Bentley Mulsanne Speed is designed for those who demand excellence in both performance and comfort. It is powered by a formidable 6.75-liter V8 twin-turbo engine, which produces 530 horsepower and an impressive 811 lb-ft of torque. This power enables the Mulsanne Speed to deliver an exhilarating driving experience while maintaining the smooth, refined ride that Bentley is renowned for. The exterior's blue finish not only adds to the vehicle’s elegance but also highlights its stately lines and classic Bentley design elements, such as the prominent front grille and assertive stance. This color choice perfectly complements the luxurious aesthetic of the Mulsanne, making it a true head-turner. Inside, the cabin of the Mulsanne Speed is a masterpiece of luxury. The tan and black interior provides a rich visual contrast, enhanced by meticulously crafted diamond-stitched leather seats that not only add a touch of elegance but also offer unparalleled comfort. The car features a state-of-the-art Naim sound system, known for its exceptional audio clarity and richness, which turns the cabin into a private concert hall. Additional luxurious amenities include rear entertainment systems that ensure passengers enjoy a first-class multimedia experience, and massage seats that provide ultimate relaxation during travel. The rear of the cabin also features a bespoke console with additional controls and storage solutions, enhancing the functionality and comfort for backseat passengers.
